name: TopicTag
statusNote: Draft: exported from @primer/react/experimental, not accessibility-reviewed, no stories and no primer.style page. It replaces the old .topic-tag CSS class used for repository topics.
summary: A blue pill linking to a repository topic. It is a link by default; use TopicTag.Group to lay several out. Choose Label for non-navigating metadata.

inputs.name: href
inputs.description: The topic's page; the default element is a link.

inputs.name: element
inputs.description: The as prop: any element; link and button get a pointer cursor and no text selection.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: A full-radius accent-muted pill with a 1px --topicTag-borderColor border (transparent except in high-contrast themes).

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.description: Small semibold accent text on one line.

anatomy.name: Group
anatomy.description: TopicTag.Group: a wrapping row with 2px between tags and 8px between lines.

layout.text: Padding is --base-size-2 (2px) top and bottom and --base-size-12 (12px) at the sides around a --text-body-lineHeight-small line of --text-body-size-small text, plus the 1px border: 25.5px tall. Width hugs the text, which never wraps.
A group is a wrapping flex row with a --base-size-2 (2px) column gap and a --base-size-8 (8px) row gap.

states.text: Fills --bgColor-accent-emphasis with --fgColor-onEmphasis text, with no transition. The hover rule applies whatever the element, so even a static span tag changes on hover.

behaviour.text: As a link it navigates, with the underline removed; as a button it is reset to an unstyled inline row before the tag styles apply. Link and button show a pointer cursor and disable text selection.

accessibility.role: link (default); button or none by the element chosen
keyboard: Tab focuses a link or button tag.
Enter follows a link; Enter or Space activates a button.
semantics: The name is the topic text.
The group is a plain container with no list semantics.

notes.text: The module draws no focus ring and no pressed state; keyboard focus shows the browser's default outline. A native build must draw a focus ring (the foundations' --focus-outline-color outline).
--topicTag-borderColor is transparent in the standard themes and a solid accent blue in the high-contrast themes, where it gives the pill an outline.
The 25.5px height is computed from 12px text at the 1.625 small line height (19.5px) plus 2px padding and 1px border each side; no rule fixes the height, so it follows the line box.
